name: How long does it take to construct a granny flat?
description: Granny flat construction typically takes 6 to 12 months, including design and permitting. Pre-fabricated options can be faster but offer less customization.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct a granny flat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for constructing a granny flat can vary significantly based on factors such as design complexity, local permitting requirements, and the availability of materials and labor. On average, from initial design to completion, a project might take anywhere from 6 to 12 months. This includes the often substantial time required for plan reviews and permit approvals by local jurisdictions in the East Bay area. A practical tradeoff is balancing a faster pre-fabricated option, which might limit customization, against a site-built unit offering greater design flexibility but potentially a longer timeline.
